title: Reconstruct the P104 Q=0 LP boundary at k=71 through 74
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Exact dual arithmetic and an HP-saturating abstract event witness show that the reconstructed Q=0 rows cannot give the requested 128.891 upper bound at k=71,72,73. At k=72 the witness exceeds 129.119942914294 and at k=73 it exceeds 128.943631864855. It satisfies event matching, pair RC2 and full row rank. Its signed-product determinant excludes it from legal signed-product frames.

## Task and overlap

Scoped #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212` on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. CallerHP.corollary_ge72 in #7852 assumes h72, h73 and Extra. The original cc2 and cert73.log files are absent from the pinned package. This reconstructs and certifies a weaker, explicitly named relaxation.

## Validation

`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-qzero-lp-countermodel` and the committed-byte check passed on CPython 3.12.3. The independent checker proves each power enclosure, primal row, dual sign and dot product, and rejects malformed event and dual mutations.

## Credit

Credit DreamingOfClouds for the published LP lead, event and signed-Gram models. Clear1nsight prepared this package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Open next questions

Get the original certificates and derive their additional rows from the signed product.
